text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba says the poor state of roads in the capital must be a result of corruption in the hiring of contractors.
- Local government minister Bennie Mwiinga warned striking council workers to resume work or face dismissal.
- Some Zairean refugees have asked Zambia's authorities to transport them to the relatively calm Zairean town of Kinsansha.
- Voting in a parliamentary by-election in the Itezhi Tezhi district in southern Zambia was brisk on Thursday.
- The government has completed drafting a bill to regulate the media.
- The government says it will not privatise state-run media.
